os_version.description: The operating system's identity, checked by the lab pack.
os_version.query: SELECT name, version, codename, arch FROM os_version

tcp_listeners.query: SELECT DISTINCT port, address FROM listening_ports WHERE protocol = 6 AND port > 0 ORDER BY port

top_processes.description: The five largest processes by resident memory.
top_processes.query: SELECT pid, name, resident_size FROM processes ORDER BY resident_size DESC LIMIT 5
